changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.46
- New overlay "first input" timer: bind a key to arm it, then your next keypress or click starts it counting. It lives in the overlay with the same move / resize / hide / accent options as the other widgets, plus separate Pause-Resume and Reset keybinds (all under a new TIMERS section in Keybinds).
- Community leaderboards now list the top 100 instead of the top 25 - scroll through the full board.
- Limiter sessions: each host/admin's choice of who to control is now private to them. A pulse only affects the players you selected, not everyone another controller picked.
